subject: Post-demo: SOC 2 Type II extracts, bridge letter & intake steps
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@carevant.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Aug 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: SOC 2 Type II extracts, bridge letter & intake steps

Hi Ellen —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can move this forward for procurement/security: 

- What we discussed: Redwood hosted inference for CareVant’s chat and summarization flows, expected steady-state throughput ~30 TPS, and the compliance items you flagged (SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA scoping, and EU data residency for a subset of records).

- Immediate asks from your side we need to unblock the procurement checklist:
  1) Copy of the most recent SOC 2 Type II report (redacted copy is fine for now).
  2) Bridge letter / interim attestation if the Type II period doesn't cover the current quarter.
  3) Trust-portal access so your security team can download artifacts (we typically use a scoped read-only bucket + time-limited link).
  4) Completed vendor DDQ — we’ll send a short questionnaire link below; completion (~15–20 min) speeds review.

I attached a short compliance_checklist_v1.pdf and a proposed mutual_action_plan_CareVant.xlsx with suggested owners and dates. Proposed timeline: if we receive the SOC2 extract + bridge letter by 2028-09-05, we can get you to legal/procurement review by 2028-09-12.

Next steps (proposed):
- Ellen: confirm whether a redacted Type II PDF is available and whether HIPAA scope applies to relevant workloads.
- Ellen/security: provide the e-mail(s) for portal access.
- Marissa: will open the portal invite and share instructions once we have the contact.

Link to DDQ: https://redwood.app/vendor-ddq/start?company=CareVant (I’ll also paste into the follow-up).

Happy to jump on a quick 15-min call if that helps coordinate timelines.

Best,
Markus Klein
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0196

Attachment stubs: compliance_checklist_v1.pdf (1 page), mutual_action_plan_CareVant.xlsx (3 sheets)
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@carevant.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: CareVant Security <security@carevant.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 10:47:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: SOC 2 Type II extracts, bridge letter & intake steps

Markus —

Thanks for the clear recap and the action plan. A few notes from security/legal side:

- We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II PDF by EOD 2028-09-04. We will redact vendor-specific client identifiers but leave control narratives and the auditor’s opinion intact. If you need a fully unredacted copy later we’ll route an NDA through legal.
- Regarding scope: our SOC 2 covers infrastructure + platform for services processing PHI; we will confirm HIPAA applicability formally but expect it to be in-scope for the planned integration.
- We can provide a bridge letter if the Type II period ends before our targeted go-live; it typically takes 2–3 business days for our compliance team to prepare.

I attached a quick scoped_coverage_matrix.csv that maps items to our compliance contacts.

DDQ: I’ve asked our security team to prioritize the vendor questionnaire — we will have a single point of contact (security@carevant.com) complete the DDQ. Please confirm the questionnaire URL again and any credentials needed.

Also, for portal access: we prefer SSO invites to security@carevant.com and a separate read-only account for procurement (procurement@carevant.com).

Thanks — Ellen
Ellen Park
Head of Procurement, CareVant Health
ellen.park@carevant.com | +1 (617) 555-4422

Attachment stub: scoped_coverage_matrix.csv (1 page)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@carevant.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: SOC 2 Type II extracts, bridge letter & intake steps

Thanks Ellen — that timeline works great. A couple clarifications and confirmed actions: 

- Redaction: fully understood. Redacted PDF is sufficient for procurement review. If legal requests full artifacts later we can facilitate via NDA.
- Bridge letter: we’ll accept a 1–2 paragraph interim attestation that covers the current control environment; appreciate the 2–3 business day estimate.
- Portal access: we’ll invite security@carevant.com and procurement@carevant.com as requested. We support SSO or one-time access links — SSO is preferred for your security team. Please confirm the SSO provider (Okta/Azure AD).

Marissa — can you initiate the trust-portal invite for CareVant and include instructions for SSO setup? Add the two emails above and set artifact retention to 30 days by default.

Ellen — the DDQ link is the same: https://redwood.app/vendor-ddq/start?company=CareVant  — no credentials needed; it’s a one-time pre-auth link tied to the company name. If your team prefers, we can also export the questionnaire as a spreadsheet and accept an emailed response.

If you’re comfortable with the plan, I’ll mark the mutual_action_plan with the timeline you proposed and loop legal/procurement next week.

Best,
Markus

> Markus —

> Thanks for the clear recap and the action plan. A few notes from security/legal side: ...

To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@carevant.com>, security@carevant.com
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 31 Aug 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: SOC 2 Type II extracts, bridge letter & intake steps

Hi Ellen / CareVant security team —

Welcome — I’m Marissa on Redwood’s security and compliance team. I’ve sent the trust-portal invite to security@carevant.com and procurement@carevant.com with SSO enabled (Okta). You should see two emails titled "Redwood: Portal access invitation" in your inbox.

Quick notes:
- Portal role: read-only artifact downloader (no edit).
- Attachment uploads: please upload the redacted SOC 2 PDF and bridge letter to the "Artifacts / SOC2" folder. We accept PDF, DOCX, and encrypted ZIPs.
- If you prefer not to use SSO, reply with the procurement contact and I’ll issue a time-limited download link instead.
- I’ve attached a short invitation_instructions.txt in case the SSO directory needs a custom attribute mapping.

HubSpot intake ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/4829/ticket/98745 — I’ve logged the plan and set a follow-up for 2028-09-06 to confirm receipt.

Let me know if you want a brief walkthrough (10–15 min) to find artifacts inside the portal.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security Programs, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment stub: invitation_instructions.txt (plain text)
